summary: Collated all ten elements of the Nineteenth Sunday after Pentecost on 1962 facsimile page images (200/400 dpi) and the 1862 antecedent's page images, swept reception for every appointed passage in registered and freshly fetched, hash-matched witnesses (Irenaeus, Hilary, Jerome, Chrysostom, Augustine, Gregory, Rabanus, Aquinas, Bellarmine, Schuster, the medieval commentators), generated the chronology record and annotations, and wrote three readings (wedding-garment, call-to-the-nations, feast-that-now-is) each carried by at least two Fathers, with 44 validated source bindings and the external-evidence declaration.
